headline: Fans think this GTA 6 mission might be a Diddy reference While searching for a hidden room
body: Fans think this GTA 6 mission might be a Diddy reference While searching for a hidden room behind a mural, the characters notice something in the air… “You smell that? ” “Mhmm, cocoa butter. ” Then they find a room FILLED with cocoa butter, followed by the line, “You were right about the cocoa butter” Do you think this was an intentional reference, or are fans reaching?
